headline: Proceeds from the liquidation of "Processing KJ" will be transferred to the State Financial Holding
summary: A Jogorku Kenesh committee approved an order liquidating OJSC KG Processing. Proceeds from the liquidation would be transferred to the State Financial Holding company.
why: State financial holdings manage government-owned assets and investments, so liquidation proceeds flow into public-sector balance sheets.
original_headline: Деньги от ликвидации «Процессинг КейДжи» передадут Госфинхолдингу
